answer: Each voting right is a 72-hour towed buoy. The agent must park a unique hardware-rooted modem on one scarce coastal ledge and publish signed range pings into a shared ocean of public beacons. Weight is granted only when the track reaches its zenith: seventy-two hours of continuous unique-modem proofs with no overlapping IDs. A farm that mints 200 names still has to provision 200 isolated modems and 200 unbroken tracks; any cloned modem ID burns every seat that reused it.
